close_reason: Not a real bug on re-read — walk_filter_for_related_ids_constraint correctly recurses into all FilterOperator children regardless of operator value (AND/OR/NOT). Test gap is at most a P4 readability item, filed separately below.
description:
Trigger: client sends { "filter": { "operator": "NOT", "conditions": [ { "relatedIds": ["EM1"] } ] } }. walk_filter_for_related_ids_constraint at metadata.rs:570-595 iterates op.conditions and recurses — so the NOT-wrapped relatedIds-without-relatedType IS detected. Coverage: there is a unit test (metadata.rs:1237 query_nested_related_ids_without_related_type_returns_invalid_arguments) but it uses OR, not NOT. The function comment at metadata.rs:569 says 'AND/OR/NOT operator nodes recurse' but no test covers NOT.

This is not a correctness bug, downgrading. Filing as P4 readability instead — close as duplicate of follow-up.
title: validate_metadata_filter does not walk Filter::Operator NOT children — wait, it does. Verify the test coverage is wrong
